home.title: JW PubliStudy
home.subtitle: A local desktop foundation for organizing the study of personal publications. In this phase the app prepares navigation, settings, and structure for future features.

import.title: Load publications
import.description: In a later phase you will be able to add and manage the publications you want to study.

search.title: Search sources
search.description: Document search will be added after loading and indexing are available.

study.title: Study with cited answers
study.description: The study area will be prepared for answers with clear references to local sources.

publications.title: Publications
publications.description: Import and manage local publications in PDF or TXT format. This phase stores only files and metadata.
publications.empty: Import a PDF or TXT file to get started.
publications.empty_filtered: No publications match the selected filters.

delete_confirm.title: Delete publication
delete_confirm.message: Do you want to delete "{title}" from the local library?

error.title: Error
error.unsupported_file: The selected file type is not supported. Use a PDF or TXT file.
error.duplicate: This publication has already been imported.
error.import_failed: The publication could not be imported.
error.delete_failed: The publication could not be deleted.
error.rename_failed: The publication could not be renamed.
error.index_failed: The publication could not be indexed.
error.delete_index_failed: The indexed chunks for this publication could not be deleted.

indexing.title: Indexing
indexing.nothing_to_index: There are no publications to index.
indexing.no_extractable_text: No extractable text was found. Scanned PDFs without text are not supported in this phase.
indexing.unsupported_type: This file type cannot be indexed.
indexing.missing_file: The imported file is no longer present in the local data directory.

study.title: Study / Chat
study.description: Search the indexed sources in your local library. In this phase search is text-based and does not use AI.

results.empty_no_index: No indexed publications. Go to Publications and index at least one file.
results.empty_query: Type a word or phrase to search.
results.empty_no_results: No results found in indexed publications.

detail.title: Result detail
detail.no_selection: Select a result to see the full chunk text.

chat.title: Local AI chat
chat.description: Ask questions using only indexed publications and your configured local model. Retrieved sources are shown below each answer.

sources_status.none: No indexed publications. Index at least one publication first.

input.placeholder: Ask a question about indexed publications...

chat.empty: Chat history is empty. Ask a question to get started.
chat.initial_hint: Ask a question about indexed publications.
chat.insufficient_sources: There is not enough information in the indexed publications to answer.
chat.insufficient_sources_suggestion: Try indexing more publications or rephrasing the question.
chat.local_model_error: I cannot contact the local AI model. Check that the local server is running and that endpoint/model are correct.
chat.answer_copied_with_sources: Last answer with sources copied to clipboard.
chat.confirm_clear_message: Do you want to delete the local chat history?
chat.remote_endpoint_warning: You are using a non-local endpoint. Questions and sources may leave this computer.

rag.insufficient_sources: There is not enough information in the indexed publications to answer.
rag.llm_error: I cannot contact the local AI model.

settings.title: Settings
settings.language_description: Choose the interface language. The preference is saved locally and applied the next time the app starts.
settings.ai_description: Configure a local server compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions. The app does not download models and does not use cloud by default.
settings.ai_privacy_remote_warning: You are using a non-local endpoint. Questions and sources may be sent outside this computer.
settings.data_description: Paths used by the app for publications, index, and chat history.
settings.maintenance_description: Tools to inspect and repair local data.

maintenance.rebuild_confirm_message: Do you want to reindex all available publications?
maintenance.reset_confirm_message: Do you want to delete all indexed chunks without deleting imported PDF/TXT files?
maintenance.clear_chat_confirm_message: Do you want to clear local chat history?
maintenance.clear_chat_failed: Chat history could not be cleared.

about.local_privacy: JW PubliStudy stores data locally on the user's computer. Chat sends questions and sources only to the configured endpoint.
